verdict.rationale: PayPal provides comprehensive public REST API documentation (auth, checkout, subscriptions, invoicing, payouts, disputes, webhooks) plus sandbox testing, OpenAPI specs/codegen, and even an official Agent Toolkit and MCP server explicitly for AI-native/agentic use. This is well beyond a documented API—first-party docs plus GitHub tooling confirm programmatic drivability. Missing for 10: independent third-party developer corroboration of API reliability/completeness beyond PayPal's own docs.
